item.name: FR07_TC016 - Price Tampering → SEC-05: SUT Should Reject Client-Provided Price

// Server MUST look up the actual price from the database (products table)

// Per spec and SEC-05, server should reject client-supplied price OR look up from DB
// This assertion will PASS currently (200) but documents the BUG

// We verify the cart doesn't return the manipulated price back

pm.expect(json).to.have.property('message');
console.log('[SEC-05] Price Tampering vulnerability confirmed: ' + JSON.stringify(json));

item.name: FR12_TC003 - BUG-01: Broken Access Control (Normal User Token on Admin API)

exec: // SPEC Section 6: 'tài khoản phải có quyền Admin' (account must have Admin role)
// SEC-01: Normal user accessing admin API MUST get 403 Forbidden
// BUG-01 CRITICAL: SUT middleware (server.js:494-525) does NOT check req.user.role === 'admin'
// → SUT returns 200 OK instead of 403 → THIS TEST WILL FAIL (correctly exposing the bug)
pm.test('[SPEC + SEC-01] Normal user MUST get 403 Forbidden on /api/admin/users (BUG-01: SUT returns 200 - FAILS)', function () {
pm.response.to.have.status(403);
pm.test('[SEC-01] Admin user list MUST NOT be accessible to normal users', function () {
// If 403, this will pass. If 200, we confirm the vulnerability
if (pm.response.code === 200) {
console.log('[BUG-01 CONFIRMED] Broken Access Control: Normal user token can access full admin user list!');
pm.expect.fail('BUG-01: Broken Access Control - Normal user can access /api/admin/users (SEC-01 violated)');

item.name: FR12_TC036 - BUG-02: Privilege Escalation via PUT /api/users/me

exec: // SPEC Section 2.2: PUT /api/users/me only allows: name, shipping_address, phone
// SEC-04: Server MUST strip/ignore the 'role' field in profile update
// BUG-02 CRITICAL: server.js:124 allows updating role field directly
// → User can set role='admin' for themselves → THIS TEST WILL FAIL
pm.test('[SPEC + SEC-04] Profile update MUST NOT allow role field (server must reject or strip role)', function () {
// If server correctly strips the role field, status is 200 but role is NOT updated in DB
// If server incorrectly updates role, this is BUG-02
pm.response.to.have.status(200);
console.log('[BUG-02] Privilege Escalation test: PUT /api/users/me with role=admin');
pm.test('[SEC-04] After update, user role MUST remain "user" (BUG-02: SUT changes role to admin - FAILS)', function () {
// We need to verify the role was NOT updated. SUT currently updates it.
// The only way to check is to verify the response or make a follow-up GET /api/users/me
// For now we log the response to show the escalation
var json = pm.response.json();
console.log('[BUG-02 CONFIRMED] Response: ' + JSON.stringify(json));
// The response contains 'Profile updated' which confirms role was accepted
// A secure server would return 400 Bad Request for unknown/forbidden field 'role'
pm.expect.fail('BUG-02: Server accepted role=admin in profile update (SEC-04 violated). User has escalated privileges!');

item.name: FR12_TC037 - BUG-05: Invalid State Transition (canceled → delivered)

exec: // SPEC Section 6.2: Order status transitions must follow valid state machine
// FR-10 State Machine: canceled is a terminal state, cannot transition to delivered
// BUG-05 HIGH: server.js:550 explicitly allows 'canceled -> delivered'
// → THIS TEST WILL FAIL (correctly exposing the bug)
pm.test('[SPEC + FR-10] canceled→delivered MUST return 400 Bad Request (BUG-05: SUT returns 200 - FAILS)', function () {
pm.response.to.have.status(400);
pm.test('[SPEC] Error message MUST mention invalid transition', function () {
if (pm.response.code === 400) {
var json = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(json).to.have.property('error');
} else {
console.log('[BUG-05 CONFIRMED] SUT allowed canceled → delivered state transition!');
pm.expect.fail('BUG-05: Invalid state transition canceled→delivered was allowed (FR-10 violated)');
